'''Travnin''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] which orbited a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the double-star [[Travnin system/Legends|Travnin system]]. It was the sector capital of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], covered in deserts and mountains with intense winds. The local day was 26 standard hours; the year was 325 local days. The main settlement was [[Travnin Spaceport]], where [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]]-implanted [[K-Series spaceport control droid]] [[K-M2]] was in charge of [[Controller droid/Legends|spaceport control]].

==History==
It was the location of a [[Sector Interdiction]] office as well as the headqurters of [[Delgad]] the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and the sector [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. The local underworld was controlled by [[Tecknel Shnick]]. Its spaceport contained [[The Grand Design]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] built a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] racing arena on Travnin, but it fell apart. When the Empire withdrew, the moon's economy plummeted.

It was the closest, coreward, of the Minos Cluster's inhabited worlds.
